comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Blast radius measured empirically (py3.12, uv sync --locked --extra dev, i.e. the exact CI lane): **38 tests** are permanently skipped, across 11 files — not just the review-bot directory.

Two modules are missing in the CI lane, not one:
- `fastapi` — from the `reviewbot` AND `ui` extras
- `jinja2` — from the `ui` extra

Everything else that is importorskip-gated (uvicorn, httpx, boto3, starlette, jsonschema, pydantic_ai, mcp, yaml, ...) already resolves transitively under `dev` — `dev` pulls `nava-rebar[agents,metrics]` plus boto3/botocore directly. So the `--extra agents` on test.yml:101 is redundant, and boto3-gated tests were never skipped.

Breakdown: 17 function-scope skips + 21 tests in 3 wholly-skipped modules.
- review-bot / opcert: test_review_bot.py (6), test_review_bot_token_redaction.py (4), test_review_bot_retrigger.py (2), test_review_bot_in_flight.py (1), test_path_injection_guards.py (1), test_opcert_service_app.py (whole module)
- audit UI (the `ui` extra, same root cause): test_audit_serve.py (1), test_audit_serve_heldout.py (1), test_plan_review_health_surfaces.py (1, jinja2), test_audit_ticket_page.py + _heldout.py (whole modules)

FINDING — two of those modules were not merely skipped, they were BROKEN: test_audit_ticket_page.py:21 and test_audit_ticket_page_heldout.py:21 do `from tests.unit import _audit_page_helpers`, but nothing ever puts the repo root on sys.path (tests/conftest.py:38 inserts tests/, not the root, and there is no tests/__init__.py). Installing fastapi turns those two modules from SKIP into a collection ERROR. Fixed to `from unit import _audit_page_helpers` (tests/ is on sys.path, so `unit` resolves as a namespace package). No other test had a latent failure — with the extras installed all 38 pass.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Fix pushed as Gerrit change 1486 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1486), **Verified +1** on patch set 1 (GH Actions run 31171494815, all 4 pytest cells green: ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 + macos py3.13). That green run is the proof of AC #1 — the previously-skipped 38 tests now actually EXECUTE in the gate.

Option chosen: add `--extra reviewbot --extra ui` to the EXISTING pytest lane install in _build-and-test.yml (the matrix job), not a dedicated lane and not folding reviewbot into `dev`.
- a dedicated lane would double the longest job in the gate (the default suite is already 15m+ on macOS and holds a scarce runner slot, ticket f3d4) for a 38-test surface;
- folding into `dev` would defeat the lean-core invariant _optionality.yml polices and push fastapi onto every contributor;
- appending an extra to an existing lane is exactly what test.yml:101 already does for `agents`.
Cost is a handful of small pure-python wheels (fastapi, jinja2, and uvicorn's uvloop/watchfiles/websockets stack). No test needs network or AWS credentials: boto3 is only touched on the best-effort CloudWatch publish in voter.py, which none of these tests exercise, and the suite's own socket guard still holds.

Regression guard (AC #3), designed to detect tests NOT RUNNING rather than an extra merely being named in a workflow file: `REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1` is set on both pytest steps, and tests/_extra_guard.py swaps `pytest.importorskip` for a variant that RAISES instead of skipping. A lost extra then reddens the build by module name — collection error for a module-scope call, test error for a function-scope one — with a message pointing at the install step. Deliberately scoped: skips keyed on a missing binary or version floor (ssh-keygen >= 8.9, Node for e2e) are `skipif`, not `importorskip`, and stay skippable.

AC #2 (deliberate break -> CI red) proven locally in the faithful form: with fastapi uninstalled, tests/unit/test_review_bot_token_redaction.py reports `4 skipped` today and `4 failed` with the guard armed; tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py goes from a whole-module skip to a collection ERROR. Full local suite with the guard armed: 10969 passed, 26 skipped — and every remaining skip is skipif-based (playwright/Node, ssh-keygen, GNU coreutils, the deliberate llm-optionality degradation cases). Zero importorskip skips remain.

Unrelated pre-existing local failure seen while verifying: tests/unit/metrics/test_jscpd_dup_heldout.py::test_live_clone (assert 0 >= 1) fails identically on untouched origin/main — already being fixed on Gerrit change 1487 (ticket 4bf4).

compiled_state.description:
## Discovered from bug e548-5b35-7eb8-4727 (bolstered-afraid-ichidna)

While root-causing e548 it was proven that the failing test is **invisible to CI**, which is how
the breaking change earned `Verified +1`.

## Evidence

- `tests/unit/test_path_injection_guards.py` guards the review-bot test with
  `pytest.importorskip("fastapi")`. Whole files do the same at module scope, e.g.
  `tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py:20-21`.
- **No CI lane ever installs fastapi.** All three install steps in
  `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml` (lines 70, 219, 295) run
  `uv sync --locked --extra dev`. The `dev` extra contains no fastapi (verified by parsing
  pyproject: `dev has fastapi? False`); fastapi lives only in the `reviewbot` and `ui` extras
  (`pyproject.toml:93`, `:100`).
- `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml:169` lists the isolation `specs=(...)` as
  agents / eval / tracing / grounding / metrics / mcp / union — **`reviewbot` is absent** — and
  that lane runs an import probe only, never pytest.
- Reproduced: `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra agents` then running the suite reports
  `SKIPPED [1] tests/unit/test_path_injection_guards.py:148: could not import 'fastapi'`.

## Why it matters

Every `rebar.review_bot` and `rebar.opcert_service` test — including SECURITY guards (the
`/rerun` 502 stack-trace-exposure guard, the `X-Opcert-Guard` 403 auth guard, the 66af token
redaction suite) — silently no-ops in CI. A change can break all of them and still be
`Verified +1`. This directly contradicts the stated invariant in the `_optionality.yml:163-168`
comment: "the isolation set is every key of `_optional.EXTRAS` — so a newly declared extra
cannot ship with ZERO CI".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A CI lane installs the `reviewbot` extra and RUNS the tests it unlocks (not just an import probe)
- [ ] Proven by seeding a deliberate break in a review-bot test and observing CI go red
- [ ] Consider a guard that fails the build when a `pytest.importorskip` skip is unlocked by no lane
compiled_state.title: review-bot + opcert tests are permanently SKIPPED in CI: no lane installs the reviewbot extra
